en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of Brașov seen through trees, with the Gothic skyline including the Black Church and the clock‑tower of the Council House rising over the old town. The reverse has a handwritten Romanian message and address, printed "Vedere din Brașov", "Editura Meridiane", "C.P.C.S." and price, plus a blue 55 BANI R.P. ROMINA postage stamp (tractor motif) with Romanian postmarks.
